title: Record page right rail: the activity timeline card has no inner padding — icons and text are clipped by the card border
body:
### Edition

ObjectOS Community (self-hosted, this repository's code)

### Version

@objectstack 18.5.0 (`objectstack dev`, objectstack-ai/hotcrm main 3617fbd)

### What happened

On a record page whose right rail carries the activity timeline card (seen on HotCRM's **Account** record page, zh-CN, desktop width ~1440px), the card's content has no inner padding and is clipped by the card border:

- the round avatar/type icons of each timeline row sit on the card's left border and are cut in half;
- the editor toolbar's send button on the right touches the right border;
- a long row such as 「更新了 客户 "江西黑猫炭黑股份有限公司"：最近活动日期」 runs into the right border and is cut before it wraps;
- the 全部动态 filter and the comment editor are flush with the card edges.

The same timeline rendered in the main column (record page → 动态 tab) has normal spacing, so this looks specific to the narrow right-rail placement.

### Steps to reproduce

1. HotCRM main, `pnpm dev`, sign in as a zh-CN user.
2. Sales → Accounts → open any account (e.g. one with a few updates).
3. Look at the 动态 card in the right rail of the 概览 tab.

### Expected

The card's content keeps the same inner padding as the other right-rail cards (联系人, 活动 …); icons and text stay inside the border.

Screenshot available from the reporter (customer account page, 2026-11-17).

Possibly belongs under #34571 (console core business UX).
